parts.style: calm, reverent, reading scripture aloud slowly
parts.text: Peace I leave with you, my peace I give unto you: <short pause> not as the world giveth, give I unto you. <short pause> Let not your heart be troubled, neither let it be afraid. <short pause> John, chapter fourteen, verse twenty-seven.
Jesus, fill me with Your peace and calm my troubled heart before I sleep. <short pause> Amen.
